reason: Approved exception #2 (consolidation plan §1.3): turbo-surf's static screenshot tier (turbo-dom-raster `layout_html`) no longer treats `t:*` as html2pdf directives; `<t:anchor/>` is an unknown, empty inline element as in Chrome. The extra xref input is the only surf corpus input containing `t:`; with `<t:anchor/>` removed or replaced by an empty `<span>` the S2+ and B2 SVGs are byte-identical (the PNG is unchanged). First observable here: surf could not build against the S2 layout API until S4.
